gate.title: Before we start — does your store already carry Sliquid?
gate.body: This page is just for partners who already stock us. If you're not carrying us yet, we'd still love to talk — we'll point you to the right form.
gate.yes: Yes — we're an existing Sliquid retailer
gate.no: Not yet — we'd like to become one

declined.title: Let's get you set up first
declined.body: This page is for stores already carrying Sliquid. Becoming a partner takes one short form — our sales team usually replies within 2–3 business days.
declined.back: Actually, we do carry Sliquid — take me back

thanks.title: Thank you — we've got it.
thanks.body: Thanks for checking in, and for the years you've spent putting Sliquid on your shelves. Your point of contact will follow up shortly.

hero.title: Thank you for always being there.
hero.body: Every bottle on your shelf is a decision you made to stand behind body-safe intimate wellness — and after twenty years, that's still the whole business. We don't take it lightly.
hero.newLook: We've refreshed how Sliquid looks and how we work with you. <bold>So — how do you like the new look?</bold> Tell us below, and let us know what you need from us next.

brands.heading: The brands behind your shelf
brands.body: Three houses, one standard. Every formula across all three is made to the same body-safe spec — glycerin-free, paraben-free, no sugar derivatives.

form.heading: Check in with us
form.intro: Three fields are all we truly need — the rest just helps us help you faster.
form.name: Your Name
form.pointOfContact: Who is your point of contact at Sliquid?
form.contactHelp: No wrong answer — if you're not sure, pick the last option and we'll route you.

contacts.notSure: Not sure / I don't have one

form.interestsHeading: How can we help right now?
form.feedbackHeading: How do you like our new look?
form.comments: Anything else you'd like to tell us?
form.commentsPlaceholder: Feedback on the new look, what's selling, what you wish we did differently…

errors.companyRequired: Store or company name is required.
errors.emailInvalid: A valid email address is required.
errors.alreadyCheckedIn: You have already checked in recently.
errors.sendFailed: Something went wrong sending your check-in. Please try again or email sales@sliquid.com directly.

notRetailer.title: Landed here but don't carry Sliquid yet?
notRetailer.body: Someone probably forwarded you this link — and we're glad they did. Our retailer and distributor application takes a couple of minutes.
